project: Red Quest - 3D Mars Interactive Map & Exploration Game
area_name: Gale Crater - Mount Sharp Gediz Vallis & Boxwork Region

terrain_height.bin.layout: Row-major, North row first (row 0 = North, row 1024 = South)
terrain_height.bin.description: Native elevation grid resampled from 1 m DEM for real-time 3D web mesh generation

terrain_height_preview.png.description: Normalized grayscale heightmap preview (0 = min elevation, 255 = max elevation)

terrain_texture.png.description: High-resolution color surface texture downsampled from native 0.25 m HiRISE orthomosaic

slope.bin.description: Surface slope angles in degrees computed from smoothed 1 m DEM

slope_classified.png.description: Categorized terrain traversability map using game-design slope tiers

route.json.description: Thinned Curiosity rover traverse (ROVER frame, ~5 m spacing) with local box coordinates

preview_check.png.description: Annotated verification hillshade map showing the rover traverse and highlighted Boxwork Zone

slope_5m.bin.description: Surface slope angles in degrees (capped at 60 deg) recomputed from smoothed 1 m DEM with 5 m baseline

slope_5m_classified.png.description: Categorized traversability map using 5 m baseline slope and game-design thresholds

easy.description: Flat to gentle slopes, accessible to all rover modes

moderate.description: Challenging incline, wheel slip possible, requires caution

hazardous.description: Steep slopes / cliffs, severe tipping risk

data_source_notes.slope_classification_disclaimer: The slope thresholds (<15 deg easy, 15-25 deg moderate, >25 deg hazardous) are game-design thresholds, not NASA limits.
data_source_notes.elevation_source: USGS / NASA PDS MSL Gale Crater 1m DEM Mosaic v3
data_source_notes.imagery_source: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona HiRISE LRGB 78-quad controlled orthomosaic (0.25 m/px)
data_source_notes.rover_traverse_source: NASA PDS MSL Rover Localization Data (localized_interp view, Sols 3721 to 4868)
data_source_notes.target_science_zone: Mount Sharp Boxwork Formations campaign, Sols 4600 to 4805
